notes.title: Play Test 22A - Boss Fight and a lot of bug fixes
notes.notes:
- added new Boss Fight
- added new simple aim assist for accessibility
- added jumping out of water, in case KB gets stuck in the ocean


Bug Fixes:
- fixed mouse cursor getting frozen in Pause Menu
- removed sliding in slow motion.  Now does Dive, which looks cooler anyway
- fixed slow mo dives to happen more consistently
- fixed aiming during slow mo dive.  Much more accurate
- fixed aiming when enemy is very close to KB
- no holstering guns animation anymore when punching
- fixed KB gun disappearing
- removed jumping uppercut
- fixed sniper scope disappearing
- removed special moves wheel menu
- reduced car jolting around when KB jumps out
- fixed KB car engine not starting sometimes
- can't pick up barrels anymore

notes.title: Play Test 19B update - Elite Weapons system update

- Elite Weapons system is more complete now

- added pressing 'I' to open the Inventory Menu

- fixed Ammo UI disappearing after Slow Mo dives

- I think I fixed the crashing when exiting back to the Main Menu, but please let me know if it still crashes.

notes.title: Play Test 17D - bug fixes and changes
notes.notes:
- there are control options for the Dive Button in the Control Option Menu now
By default it is set to slow mo dive always.  
You can set it to the 2nd option:  Tap to fast dive / Hold to slow mo dive


- KB guns range is a little farther and does more minimum damage.  It is also louder (enemies can hear it from farther away)

- Snipers will double their vision range if they are shot.

- I fixed bullets going through walls.

notes.title: Play Test 14D - new graphics settings for big fps boost, lots of bug fixes
notes.notes:
NEW:
- new Graphics Settings: (low, medium, default, high). It should give some big performance boosts in lower settings
- camera control settings: invert Y axis, camera smoothing, camera slow motion speed multiplier

CHANGED:
- added double jump back for more fun
- KB starts with 100 dramatic points for more fun
- guns are way more accurate at close range and slow mo dives
- do more damage during slow mo dives
- street lights and traffic lights in the city are easier to ram off
- removed Spatial Temporal anti-aliasing.  This caused a lot of low framerates.  You won't miss it though, because fps is faster now.

FIXED:
- fixed beans falling through terrain
- fixed car pile up in the City map
- purple beans from the armored truck can now be killed (the hit boxes were missing)
- fixed 4 arms appearing when reloading in 1st person
- weapon icons show on Map now after hacking devices
